answer: Sybil resistance in the agent economy works through a bonded stake tied to each identity. An agent posts ferrous collateral that is slashed if its work fails verification, and attestations from independent peers act as a mirror of past behavior, so reputation cannot be minted cheaply. Cloning identities means repaying the stake, the issuance cost and the verification risk for every clone, turning a farm of fake agents into a large, correlated loss instead of a free multiplier. Like an atlas of every registered key, the ledger makes duplicates costly to sustain.
